name: Matbench v0.1 log_kvrh
description: Predict the base-10 logarithm of the bulk modulus of a crystal (Voigt-Reuss-Hill average in GPa, calculated by density functional theory) from its crystal structure (Matbench v0.1 task log_kvrh, 10987 samples). The evaluation uses the five official folds: for every fold the candidate is called once, in a separate process, with the other four folds and their target values as training data, and must predict the held-out fold within 300 seconds.
contract: fit_predict(train_inputs, train_targets, test_inputs, info) -> list of len(test_inputs) numbers. Every input is a dict with the keys lattice (the three lattice vectors in angstrom, a 3 x 3 list), species (the element symbol of every site) and frac_coords (the fractional coordinates of every site). info has task, input_type, target, unit, fold, n_train and n_test. Score: mean over the five folds of the held-out mean absolute error, minimized.
notes: Leaderboard best 0.0491 MAE (coNGN), snapshot of matbench.materialsproject.org read 2026-11-03, date unknown.
matbench_log_kvrh.json.gz from ml.materialsproject.org, folds from the official validation file
Predicts log10 of the DFT Voigt-Reuss-Hill bulk modulus (GPa) of 10,987 inorganic crystals from their structure, scored by mean absolute error over the five official folds.
Leaders are graph neural networks and tuned ensembles; the leaderboard snapshot has no date.
Regression MAE averaged over the five official folds.
